session_metrics.context: single continuing subagent session; only local walls, coordinates, size, exit and action feedback
session_metrics.isolation: no inherited task history; only the game interface is allowed; no file/source access; broker omits seed and full map. Instruction-based isolation, not an OS sandbox.
session_metrics.latency_definition: environment emission to submitted action, includes model and orchestration; not pure inference latency
session_metrics.agent_active_definition: sum of subagent task-start to task-complete intervals, includes its game tool calls; excludes parent dispatch gaps; not pure inference time
session_metrics.controller_notes: First 28 actions were parent-relayed; the 600s broker deadline expired during dispatch/questions. Same player session and exact game state then resumed through a game-only HTTP endpoint. Two failed terminal-handle calls made no game moves. Total broker wall time includes the first segment; no full maze or seed was supplied to the player.
